newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices -April 21.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices -April 21.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers eased slightly over the day as sellers undercut prices to get rid of stocks, traders said on Monday. "Enquiries were healthy as most shipowners emerged to buy after the three day break over the holiday weekend," said one trader. "There may be less demand tomorrow as most buyers have already made their purchases today," said one major.
